meta.name: Jose Israel Flores
meta.title: iOS Software Engineer
meta.tagline: Building cloud-connected vehicle features for millions of users across 4 brands and 4 regions.

education.school: The University of Texas at Dallas

bullets: Design, implement, and maintain cloud-connected features for the Toyota/Lexus/Subaru connected vehicle platform across 4 brands and 4 regions, serving millions of monthly active users
Converted multiple features from Flutter to native Swift (EV Wallet, navigation, POI) as part of a platform-wide modernization effort, improving performance and reducing build complexity
Built remote vehicle command features using GraphQL subscriptions and real-time telemetry, working with backend teams to ensure reliability across cloud services
Drove security compliance across the iOS codebase — implementing TLS 1.3 enforcement, migrating API parameters to request bodies, and hardening endpoints against known vulnerability patterns

Built a local AI-integrated developer tool (MCP server) from scratch that automates account management, cross-platform E2E testing, release notes generation, and API mocking — piloted new technologies (LLMs, Model Context Protocol) and drove adoption across the mobile engineering team
Implemented "Data Transmission Off" privacy controls and feature flag integrations (LaunchDarkly), upholding technical standards for gradual rollouts and operational safety
Delivered key features for the Australian/New Zealand market launch, collaborating with cross-functional teams (backend, QA, product) to align regional requirements with platform capabilities
Onboarded 5–6 engineers including knowledge transfer on architecture, tooling, and codebase conventions; participate in first-round technical interviews and promote Agile best practices

experience.subtitle: UTD Computer Science Senior Project
bullets: Developed a children's learning platform with AR functionality using Swift and Firebase
Collaborated across two software engineering teams, one hardware team, and one UI/UX designer
Closed 20+ bugs and vulnerabilities in a .NET system using SonarQube
Added Regex validation to auto loan input fields to prevent SQL injection attacks
Served as project manager for 7-person intern team

projects.name: Toyota Mobile MCP Server
projects.description: Local AI-integrated developer tool built from scratch, piloting emerging technology (Model Context Protocol + LLMs) to automate mobile team workflows:
bullets: Automated STG/prod account management with credential validation, OTP handling, and password resets
Cross-platform E2E test automation via Appium with YAML-driven test cases, live debugging, and screen recognition
Release notes generation from GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines and Jira aggregation
API response mocking through Proxyman for isolated cloud-service testing
PR review status reports and Jira/Confluence workflow integration
Demoed to engineering leadership; now used by multiple mobile engineers daily
